cohort: 7394 individuals born in Olmsted County, MN between 1976 and 1982, with clinic visits after age 18 years
finding: While several perinatal factors were associated with severe obesity and dyslipidemia in adulthood, birthweight for gestational age was not independently associated with either outcome.
mod_finding: This study found that mode of delivery (singleton vs. multiple birth) was independently associated with both severe obesity and dyslipidemia in adulthood.
